title: [3.1.0.3-dev-b] profile shift multiplies
body:
Did a profile shift of +2 hours for 100 minutes and now it replicates over time. either a graph label and treatments record
Interesting is that main AAPS has only graph labels multiplied, the treatments list is fine. But nsclient has multiple records both in treatments and graph.

![Screenshot_20221023_094359](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4157587/197378160-8aba4c82-3ccc-483f-8505-50c3464a2ba1.jpg)

![Screenshot_20221023-094325_NSClient](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4157587/197378163-a7f9195f-bf34-4b0b-b2a0-62c28c98aa09.jpg)

comments.body: hmm, seems to be somehow related to aaps/nsclient version difference. updated nsclient and it stopped.
